title: classroom50 progress data
description: Collection data for one classroom, generated by scripts/generate_progress.py and committed by the publish workflow. Lives at <classroom>/data/progress.json. Not edited by hand.

generated_at.description: When this snapshot was generated (UTC). Ignored by content-change detection.

collected_at.description: When scores for this assignment were last collected. Ignored by content-change detection.

display.description: Full name from the roster, or the username as fallback.

cells.description: One entry per (student, assignment) with at least one collected submission.

fix_submitted.description: True when the last verdict on the PR is CHANGES_REQUESTED and the student re-submitted after that review was posted: the fix is back 'under review' until the teacher re-reviews. False for every other state.

last_student_comment.description: Latest comment authored by the student on the Feedback PR (conversation or inline review thread). Teacher-side discussion triage signal; not rendered on the status page. Absent when the student never commented.
